text: This staff report responds to the request for the General Manager, Solid Waste Management Services, in consultation with the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation, to report back at the September 17, 2020 Infrastructure and Environment Committee meeting on the impact that COVID-19 has had on waste collection and litter in greenspaces and parks.
The Infrastructure and Environment Committee received the report (August 21, 2020) from the General Manager, Solid Waste Management Services for information.
